digest.component_or_area: Plan-review gate documentation and author-facing guides
propositions: Authors must de-risk risky runtime mechanisms via fast out-of-loop proof (local run or manual probe against real target) before committing them to slow codified delivery loops (CI/CD, IaC apply, provisioning).
The packaged plan guide must name the risky mechanisms, describe the two permitted proof forms, and document that throwaway experiment teardown is scoped only to resources created by that experiment.
Documentation must identify the de-risk guidance as criterion T15 and remain stack-agnostic without hardcoded product-specific tooling like Terraform or Docker.
The hand-authored plan-review-gate.md overlay enumeration must be updated from T1–T12 to T1–T15 and the stated criterion count aligned to the validated registry (44 criteria).
The registry module docstring and criterion-pins.json manifest must be regenerated and kept in sync with the validated vocabulary and author-facing documentation.
